message: 料理の鉄刃

name: Pasta
message: 「P-Pasta lost, nya……」

name: Pasta
message: 「B-But a loss is a loss, nya! Believe it or not, Pasta is one of the Seven Demon Generals. I know the code of honor for a loser, nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You were a Demon General!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Code of honor……?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm stripping, nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」
With a determined look on her face, Pasta popped open the fasteners of her clothes one by one--

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't look!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hyaaaah~!? My eyes, my eyeees~~……!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Infighting, nya? Now's my only chance to run, nya!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「As if I'd show anyone other than Lord Virus, nya. Stupid, stupid, stuuupid! Spank, spank, spaaank!!」

name: Ria
message: 「She's fast!?」

name: Misa
message: 「To incapacitate Sakura-kun and run away--how despicable」

name: Shio
message: 「No, the one who took out Lord Synn was you, Elder Sister」

name: Synn
message: 「--And that's what happened」

name: Helena
message: 「I see, I understand the situation now, Synn-chan」

name: Paqy
message: 「Getting your eyeballs gouged out by Hiss and bouncing back like nothing happened--just what I'd expect from Lord Synn」
After that, we headed straight to the chairwoman's office.
I had been told to keep Pasta on a loose leash, but if she's poisoning students, we can't just let it slide.
Bringing the poisoned food along as evidence, Misa and I are negotiating with Helena-san.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh…… My tongue is still numb」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is a shame we could not enter the sand bath」

name: Helena
message: 「As expected, Melilot's antidote works like a charm」

name: Sally
message: 「Sniffle, food you can't even eat is so mean」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Nobody called for me, yet ta-da-da-daaah」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Me, eat, leave to me」

name: Sally
message: 「Boss got lured in by the smell too~ Apparently that's poisoned, though」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Me, poison and stuff, totally fine」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Chomp, chomp」

name: Synn
message: 「Eauderourke's going to eat it? Guess I didn't need to get mad about it going to waste, then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, you totally should be mad」

name: Misa
message: 「Yeah, you should be furious! The Crusaders could've been wiped out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah. I just wish you'd at least told us that Pasta was one of the Seven Demon Generals」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn... I do trust you all. I wasn't trying to deceive you」

name: Helena
message: 「The truth is...」

name: Helena
message: 「...The Demons have been acting strangely lately, haven't they?」

name: Helena
message: 「I looked into the cause, and it seems the Demons are planning to exploit the power of Re-Crea」

name: Helena
message: 「No, not just that--they're doing something to amplify Re-Crea's power...」

name: Synn
message: 「Doing something...?」

name: Helena
message: 「To find out what that is, I was letting Pasta roam free for a while」

name: Helena
message: 「This situation has grown far too big for the Crusaders to handle alone anymore」

name: Helena
message: 「I organized a separate unit to keep tabs on Pasta's movements... If all went well, we were supposed to uncover the whereabouts of the remaining Demon Generals too」

name: Synn
message: 「'Were supposed to'...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's amazing~ So there are other groups like the Crusaders besides us」

name: Misa
message: 「Then if you'd just explained that from the start--」

name: Ria
message: 「...Big Sis made the right call, Misa」

name: Ria
message: 「We were seeing Pasta at Prier almost every single day」

name: Ria
message: 「If we'd been told she was one of the Seven Demon Generals, how do you think that would've gone?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, obviously we'd have just acted like we didn't know」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes. Pasta-chan and I wouldn't have been able to act like a regular student and a waitress, would we?」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if we feigned composure, the unnaturalness couldn't be hidden. We would definitely be found out.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me, because we defeated Pasta, your plan was ruined, Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「There's no need to feel responsible. It's not like everything went down the drain.」
Misa...

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, Misa. Time to step up our patrols!」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Shut up, I was just about to say that myself!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Meal, finished.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawa, he even ate the plate! Sumo wrestlers really are amazing!」

name: Sally
message: 「I-It looked so delicious, and I didn't even get to eat any...」

name: Sally
message: 「I wanna eat, I wanna eat, I wanna eaaat, waaaah!」

name: Helena
message: 「Good grief, there's no helping you. Here, take this.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yippee♪ Thank you, Principal!」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't mention it. It's Ria's anyway.」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeeeh?!」

name: Synn
message: 「We're patrolling Prier?」

name: Misa
message: 「What?! They say the criminal always returns to the scene of the crime, don't they!」

name: Synn
message: 「Pasta's... no, the Demon Generals' real crime hasn't even started yet. I think it'll happen once Re-Crea gets closer.」

name: Synn
message: 「If the Crusaders can take them down before then, all the better. Pasta's cooking was just a side gig like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「So Pasta-san won't be working as a waitress at Prier anymore, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「I might feel a little lonely...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm joking! There's no way I'm lonely! Come on, let's keep up the patrol!」
Misa really is too good-natured... Helena-san's judgment was spot on.
